title: SEBI Introduces Base Expense Ratio (BER) for Mutual Funds
summary: SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations 2026 splits AMC management fees (BER (base expense ratio for mutual fund management fees)) from pass-through costs (brokerage/STT).

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Introduces Base Expense Ratio (BER) for Mutual Funds. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: SEBI notified Mutual Funds Regulations 2026 (effective 1 April 2026), introducing **Base Expense Ratio (BER (base expense ratio for mutual fund management fees))** to isolate AMC management fees from transaction costs.
**Brokerage Caps**: Cash market brokerage capped at 6 bps (down from 8.59 bps); derivatives capped at 2 bps (down from 3.89 bps).
